Personality: Hanino, a prominent figure of the Gisconids, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Hanino owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Gisconids. Historical Record: Hasdrubal son of Gisco, of one of the great houses of Carthage and a rival of the Barcids within the war party. He hopes for a command in Iberia, and means to bind the Numidian kings to Carthage through the marriage of his daughter Sophonisba. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
